rules.expression: (cf.client.bot) or (http.user_agent contains "Baiduspider") or (http.user_agent contains "Googlebot") or (http.user_agent contains "bingbot") or (http.user_agent contains "Sogou") or (http.user_agent contains "360Spider") or (http.user_agent contains "YisouSpider") or (http.user_agent contains "Yandex") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/robots.txt") or (http.request.uri.path contains "sitemap")

(http.request.uri.path eq "/wp-login.php") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/xmlrpc.php") or (http.request.uri.path contains "wlwmanifest") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-admin/") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-content/plugins/") or (http.request.uri.path contains "install.php") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/login") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/dashboard") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/.env") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/.git") or (http.request.uri.path contains "phpmyadmin") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/config.") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/admin.php") or (http.request.uri.path contains ".sql") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/health")

(http.user_agent contains "python-requests") or (http.user_agent contains "curl/") or (http.user_agent contains "Go-http-client") or (http.user_agent contains "masscan") or (http.user_agent contains "sqlmap") or (http.user_agent contains "Nikto") or (http.user_agent contains "Wget") or (http.user_agent contains "zgrab") or (http.user_agent contains "Nuclei")

(http.request.uri.path contains ".php") and not (http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-admin/" or http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-includes/" or http.request.uri.path contains "wp-content/plugins/" or http.request.uri.path contains "wp-content/themes/" or http.request.uri.path contains "index.php" or http.request.uri.path contains "wp-login.php" or http.request.uri.path contains "wp-cron.php" or http.request.uri.path contains "wp-comments-post.php" or http.request.uri.path contains "wp-trackback.php" or http.request.uri.path contains "xmlrpc.php")

(http.request.uri.path contains "/secrets.json") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/service_account.json") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/credentials.json") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/@fs/") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/latest/meta-data") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/actuator") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/.aws/") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/.ssh/") or (http.request.uri.path contains "readme.html") or (http.request.uri.path contains "license.txt")
